      "informal_name": "Vandermonde Determinant Equals Monic Polynomial Evaluation Determinant",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),\n  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) →\n    (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => Polynomial.eval (v i) (p j)).det",

      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),\n  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree ≤ ↑i) →\n    (Matrix.of fun i j => Polynomial.eval (v i) (p j)) = Matrix.vandermonde v * Matrix.of fun i j => (p j).coeff ↑i",

items.informal_name: Vandermonde Determinant Equals Monic Polynomial Evaluation Determinant
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => Polynomial.eval (v i) (p j)).det
items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ R $, a vector $ v $ of length $ n $ with entries in $ R $, and a sequence of monic polynomials $ p_0, p_1, \ldots, p_{n-1} $ over $ R $ where each $ p_i $ has degree $ i $, the determinant of the $ n \times n $ Vandermonde matrix formed by $ v $ is equal to the determinant of the matrix whose $ (i,j) $-entry is $ p_j(v_i) $, the evaluation of polynomial $ p_j $ at $ v_i $. This equality holds under the conditions that each polynomial is monic and has natural degree equal to its index.

items.informal_name: Determinant of a Matrix of Monic Polynomials with Degree Conditions Equals One
items.type:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) → (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.of fun i j => (p j).coeff ↑i).det = 1
items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ R $ and natural number $ n $, consider monic polynomials $ p_0, p_1, \ldots, p_{n-1} $ in $ R[X] $ where each $ p_i $ has degree $ i $. Construct an $ n \times n $ matrix $ M $ such that the entry in row $ i $ and column $ j $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p_j $. Then the determinant of $ M $ is equal to 1.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree ≤ ↑i) →
    (Matrix.of fun i j => Polynomial.eval (v i) (p j)) = Matrix.vandermonde v * Matrix.of fun i j => (p j).coeff ↑i
items.informal_description: For a vector $ v $ of length $ n $ in a commutative ring $ R $ and a family of polynomials $ p_j $ over $ R $ with $ \deg(p_j) \leq j $, the matrix whose entries are $ p_j(v_i) $ equals the product of the Vandermonde matrix of $ v $ and the matrix of coefficients of $ p_j $. Formally, $ [p_j(v_i)] = V(v) \cdot [\text{coeff}_i(p_j)] $, where $ V(v) $ is the Vandermonde matrix with entries $ v_i^j $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R),
  (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = ∏ i, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j - v i)
items.informal_description: The determinant of the Vandermonde matrix constructed from a vector $ v $ of length $ n $ with entries in a commutative ring $ R $ is equal to the product of $ (v_j - v_i) $ for all $ 0 \leq i < j < n $. Formally, $ \det(\text{vandermonde}(v)) = \prod_{0 \leq i < j < n} (v_j - v_i) $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v w : Fin n → R),
  (Matrix.projVandermonde v w).det = ∏ i, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j * w i - v i * w j)
items.informal_description: The determinant of the $n \times n$ generalized Vandermonde matrix with entries $(v_i^j w_i^{n-1-j})$ is equal to the product over all $0 \le i < j < n$ of $(v_j w_i - v_i w_j)$, i.e., $\det(\text{Vandermonde}(v,w)) = \prod_{0 \le i < j < n} (v_j w_i - v_i w_j)$.

items.name: Matrix.det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),

    (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => Polynomial.eval (v i) (p j)).det

items.name: Matrix.det_vandermonde
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R),
  (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = ∏ i, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j - v i)

items.name: Matrix.det_projVandermonde

items.name: eval_det
items.type:
∀ {n : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type u_3} [inst_2 : CommRing R]
  (M : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) (r : R),
  Polynomial.eval r M.det = (Polynomial.eval ((Matrix.scalar n) r) (matPolyEquiv M)).det

items.name: Matrix.det_matrixOfPolynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) → (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.of fun i j => (p j).coeff ↑i).det = 1

items.name: eval_det_add_X_smul
items.type: {n : Type w} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) (M : Matrix n n R) : Polynomial.eval 0 (A + Polynomial.X • M.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det = Polynomial.eval 0 A.det

items.name: eval_det
items.type: {n : Type w} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) (r : R) : Polynomial.eval r M.det = (Polynomial.eval ((Matrix.scalar n) r) (matPolyEquiv M)).det

items.name: Matrix.eval_charpoly
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {m : Type u_3} [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m] (M : Matrix m m R) (t : R) : Polynomial.eval t M.charpoly = ((Matrix.scalar m) t - M).det

items.name: Matrix.det_one_add_smul
items.type: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : Type v} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (r : R) (M : Matrix n n R) : (1 + r • M).det = 1 + M.trace * r + Polynomial.eval r (1 + Polynomial.X • M.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.divX.divX * r ^ 2

items.name: Matrix.derivative_det_one_add_X_smul
items.type: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : Type v} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (M : Matrix n n R) : Polynomial.eval 0 (Polynomial.derivative (1 + Polynomial.X • M.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det) = M.trace

items.name: Matrix.derivative_det_one_add_X_smul_aux
items.type: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) : Polynomial.eval 0 (Polynomial.derivative (1 + Polynomial.X • M.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det) = M.trace

items.name: Matrix.det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → Polynomial R) (h_deg : ∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) (h_monic : ∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) : (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => Polynomial.eval (v i) (p j)).det

items.name: Algebra.Norm.Transitivity.eval_zero_det_det
items.type: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {n : Type u_4} {m : Type u_5} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (M : Matrix m m S) [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (k : m) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (f : S →+* Matrix n n R) : Polynomial.eval 0 (f.polyToMatrix (Algebra.Norm.Transitivity.cornerAddX M k).det).det = (f M.det).det

items.name: Algebra.Norm.Transitivity.eval_zero_comp_det
items.type: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {n : Type u_4} {m : Type u_5} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (M : Matrix m m S) [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (k : m) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (f : S →+* Matrix n n R) : Polynomial.eval 0 ((Matrix.comp m m n n (Polynomial R)) ((Algebra.Norm.Transitivity.cornerAddX M k).map ⇑f.polyToMatrix)).det = ((Matrix.comp m m n n R) (M.map ⇑f)).det
